title: prunus serrulata var. glabra
intro: Prunus serrulata var. glabra, commonly known as naked Japanese cherry or smooth cherry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include lowering inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and enhancing antioxidant defenses. The therapeutic actions of Prunus serrulata var. glabra may include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can aid in wound healing and immune system support. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
